title: Kamiyadori
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a dark future a contagious virus turns living things, including people, into monsters called Kamiyadori. A police special unit, the Right Arms, uses Kamiyadori power to exterminate the infected without mercy; one agent begins to doubt the killing, while his partner Vivi has no such doubts, and an encounter with an infected boy and his sister sets events in motion.
life_message: Mercy and doubt toward a system of killing can open a path of hope in a merciless world.

content.note: Graphic violence and executions of the infected, including children (review; MU Blood and Gore, Execution).
Body horror and an apocalyptic plague (AniList Body Horror; publisher blurb).
Nudity noted by reviewer; AniList and MU list Nudity, MU 'Shameless Female Lead' and 'Loli'; artist known for adult work (MU). Age of the nude character not stated (to verify).
An agent doubts his purpose after many killings (review).
